name: adx0-extension
description: A browser extension that blocks ads on pages and in YouTube videos

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/background.ts src/page.ts src/player.ts src/skip.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --charset=utf8 --format=iife --target=firefox128,chrome120 --outdir=web && node tools/pack.ts
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run types && npm test && npm run bundle
